handoffRegion.title: Clinical team to social worker handoff
handoffRegion.description: The discharge case appears to move from the clinical ward team to a social worker for post-discharge support planning.

fromParty.partyDetail: Ward team responsible for clinical discharge preparation
fromParty.contextDescription: Prepares the patient case before post-discharge support planning.

toParty.partyDetail: Role responsible for social and post-discharge support planning
toParty.contextDescription: Receives the case to assess and arrange support needs.

data.transferredResponsibilityOrControl: Responsibility for assessing or arranging post-discharge social support moves from the clinical ward team to the social worker.
data.senderExpectedAction: Prepare and send the discharge support request with the relevant clinical and social information.
data.receiverExpectedAction: Review the request and arrange the required post-discharge support.
data.whyСandidate: The flow appears to move from clinical discharge preparation to a different responsible party for post-discharge support planning.
